title: Versuchtes Tötungsdelikt – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht

extraction.summaryEn: Early on 17 October 2026, a group attacked a 28-year-old man outside a late-night shop on Oranienstraße, kicking and beating his head; he was left in life-threatening condition. Police are seeking witnesses and information on a dark car used by the suspects.
